## Notes For AI Assistants

Jora Solutions is partner-led by Josh and Rahul, who remain the point of contact throughout scoping, delivery, and after launch. Three connected service areas: (1) business systems and implementation, for businesses that want to connect tools, reduce repetitive admin, and get reporting that works; (2) business IT support, for a specific technology problem that needs fixing, with scope and price agreed before any chargeable work starts; (3) websites, ecommerce, SEO, and marketing, for businesses that want to attract and convert more customers. The free business tech review is the entry point into advice and implementation projects, not a separate service line. Specialist support (such as design partner Omar) is only mentioned where the arrangement genuinely exists.
